name: Only One
source: Game about boy, who had lived quietly until he discovered the truth about his destiny. The boy will have to choose who is going to die. Only he can destroy the original hybrid - Niklaus and save the world.
translation: 故事讲述了一位原本过着平静生活的少年，直到他发现了自己命运的真相。他必须决定谁将死去。只有他能消灭始祖混血者尼克劳斯，拯救世界。
